Upcoming Dates and Deadlines

See the Academic Calendar

Oct 12

Fall Break

PNW will observe Fall Break on Monday and Tuesday, October 12 and 13, 2026. There are no classes, but campus offices are open, with some exceptions.

Oct 26

Spring 2027 Priority Registration Begins

Register for classes during Priority Registration to get the best selection of class days and times!

Nov 13

Last Day to Drop a Full-Term Fall 2026 Course

The last day to drop a Full-Term Fall 2026 Course is Friday, November 13, 2025, at 4:30 p.m.

Dec 12

Fall 2026 Classes End

Fall 2026 Classes end on December 12. Next week are final exams! Make sure to study and enjoy your break after!
